create_contraction_augmenter: create a ContractionAugmenter with a probability and mapping dict to replace words with contractions
augment_text_with_contractions: augment a list of text strings by substituting words with their contraction mappings
substitute_contractions_in_text: substitute contractions in a single text string using a configured ContractionAugmenter instance
create_contraction_mapping_from_json: create a ContractionMapping from a JSON file path to load contraction replacement pairs
replace_contraction_with_mapping: replace a word or phrase using a ContractionMapping and get the contracted form
